"use client";
import {useState} from 'react';
import {ArrowUpRight,Download,RefreshCw} from 'lucide-react';
import {GmailCodes,AuthenticatorCodes} from './account-google-tools';
import {weeklyWindow,remaining,isLive,type QuotaProfile} from '@/lib/quota';
import {officialFieldStamp} from '@/lib/quota-evidence';
import {useAccountQueries,accountQueryLabel} from './use-account-queries';

export type DetailTab='plan'|'resets'|'history'|'mail'|'auth';
const stamp=(value?:string|number|null)=>value?new Date(typeof value==='number'?value*1000:value).toLocaleString('zh-CN',{timeZone:'Asia/Taipei',year:'numeric',month:'numeric',day:'numeric',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hour12:false}):'暂未提供';
const plan=(value?:string|null)=>value?({pro:'Pro',plus:'Plus',free:'Free',team:'Team',business:'Business',enterprise:'Enterprise'}[value]||value):'套餐待查询';
const percentage=(p:QuotaProfile,minutes:number)=>{const value=remaining(p.windows.find(w=>w.windowDurationMins===minutes));return value===null?'—':`${value}%`;};
function expiry(value:number|null,now:number,noExpiry?:boolean,dateLabel?:string){if(!value)return dateLabel?'具体到期时刻暂未提供':noExpiry?'无固定到期时间':'暂未提供';const minutes=Math.ceil((value*1000-now)/60000);return value*1000<=now?'已到期':`剩余 ${Math.floor(minutes/1440)} 天 ${Math.floor(minutes%1440/60)} 小时 ${minutes%60} 分钟`;}
type Props={email:string;profile?:QuotaProfile;history:QuotaProfile[];lastSeen?:string;total:number|null;currentEmail:string|null;now:number;tab:DetailTab;onTab:(value:DetailTab)=>void;onStatistics:()=>void;canManage:boolean;onRefresh:()=>void};
export default function AccountDetails({email,profile:storedProfile,history,lastSeen,total,currentEmail,now,tab,onTab,onStatistics,canManage,onRefresh}:Props){
  const [openingBilling,setOpeningBilling]=useState(false),[billingMessage,setBillingMessage]=useState(''),[billingError,setBillingError]=useState('');
  const autoQuery=useAccountQueries(canManage,onRefresh);
  const profile=storedProfile;
  async function queryQuota(){await autoQuery.request(email);}
  async function openBilling(){setOpeningBilling(true);setBillingMessage('');setBillingError('');try{const response=await fetch(`/api/local-apps/identity/open-billing?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:'{}'}),body=await response.json() as {error?:string;opened?:boolean;expectedEmail?:string;profileLabel?:string};if(!response.ok)throw new Error(body.error||'此账号的账单页面暂时无法打开。');if(body.opened!==true||body.expectedEmail!==email.toLowerCase())throw new Error('未能确认对应的 Chrome 个人资料，请重试。');setBillingMessage(`已在 Chrome「${body.profileLabel||'对应账号'}」中打开官方账单。请先核对账单邮箱是否与当前所选账号一致。`);}catch(error){setBillingError(error instanceof Error?error.message:'此账号的账单页面暂时无法打开。');}finally{setOpeningBilling(false);}}
  const entries=[...new Map([...(profile&&!profile.officialFields?.length?[profile]:[]),...history.filter(p=>p.email.toLowerCase()===email.toLowerCase())].map(p=>[`${p.source}:${p.observedAt}`,p])).values()].sort((a,b)=>b.observedAt.localeCompare(a.observedAt));
  const reset=profile?.resetCredits;
  const billing=profile?.officialEvidence?.billing;
  const planEvidenceAt=officialFieldStamp(profile??undefined,'planType'),resetEvidenceAt=officialFieldStamp(profile??undefined,'resetCredits'),locator=canManage?profile?.officialEvidence?.locator:undefined,resetHistory=profile?.officialEvidence?.resetHistory;
  function download(){const report={email,exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(),profile:profile??null,history:entries};const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(report,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}));const link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download=`codex-account-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.json`;link.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);}
  return <>
    {canManage&&<div className="quota-query-state"><button className="google-quota-refresh" disabled={autoQuery.saving} onClick={queryQuota}>{autoQuery.saving?'正在提交…':'查询此账号官网信息'}</button><p role="status">{autoQuery.error||accountQueryLabel(autoQuery.queries.find(q=>q.email===email||q.verified_email===email))}</p></div>}
    <div className="quota-detail-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="账号查询内容">{([['plan','套餐与充值'],['resets','重置卡'],['history','历史额度'],['mail','Gmail 验证码'],['auth','二次认证']] as const).map(([value,title])=><button key={value} role="tab" id={`quota-tab-${value}`} aria-selected={tab===value} aria-controls="quota-detail-panel" onClick={()=>onTab(value)}>{title}</button>)}</div>
    <div id="quota-detail-panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby={`quota-tab-${tab}`} className="quota-detail-panel">
    {tab==='plan'&&<>
      <div className="quota-plan-summary"><div><small>当前已读取套餐</small><strong>{plan(profile?.planType)}</strong></div><span>{planEvidenceAt?`官方页面核验 · ${stamp(planEvidenceAt)}`:isLive(profile??undefined,now,currentEmail)?'当前登录 · 实时':profile?'历史快照':'等待登录查询'}</span></div>
      <dl className="quota-detail-list"><div><dt>{billing?(billing.value.autoRenew?'自动续订日':billing.value.periodEndDate?'会员到期日':'续订日期'):'会员到期时间'}</dt><dd>{billing?(billing.value.autoRenew?billing.value.renewalDate:billing.value.periodEndDate||billing.value.renewalDate)?.replace(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/,'$1年$2月$3日'):stamp(profile?.subscription?.activeUntil)}</dd></div><div><dt>额外额度余额</dt><dd>{profile?.balance??'暂未提供'}</dd></div></dl>
      <p className="quota-dialog-note">{billing?`${billing.source==='official-screenshot'?'官方账单截图':'官方账单页面'}核验于 ${stamp(billing.observedAt)}。会员日期按账单原文保存，未推算具体时刻。`:'会员日期为最近核验的订阅期；续费、取消及最终扣款时间以官方账单为准。'}</p>
      <section className="quota-billing"><h3>官方充值与套餐管理</h3><p>绑卡入口按所选邮箱打开这台电脑上对应的 Chrome 个人资料。官方账单邮箱需与所选账号一致。</p>{canManage?<button className="google-quota-refresh" disabled={openingBilling} onClick={openBilling}><ArrowUpRight size={16}/>{openingBilling?'正在打开对应账号…':'在对应 Chrome 账号中绑卡 / 管理套餐'}</button>:<a className="quota-billing-primary" href="/signin-with-chatgpt?return_to=%2F%23tokens" target="_top">登录网站管理账号后打开对应账单<ArrowUpRight size={16}/></a>}{billingMessage&&<p className="google-query-success" role="status">{billingMessage}</p>}{billingError&&<p className="quota-error" role="alert">{billingError}</p>}<small>电脑和本机采集器需在线。打开对应个人资料后，请在官方页确认账单邮箱，再添加支付方式或管理套餐。<a href="https://help.openai.com/en/articles/9039756-managing-billing-for-chatgpt-and-the-api-platform" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">官方账单帮助</a></small><a href={locator?.usageUrl||'https://chatgpt.com/settings/usage?tab=overview'} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">查看官方额度页面<ArrowUpRight size={16}/></a><a href="https://chatgpt.com/pricing/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">查看官方套餐与价格<ArrowUpRight size={15}/></a></section>
      {locator&&<details className="quota-more-details"><summary>官方页面定位与邮箱核验</summary><p className="quota-dialog-note">上次核验邮箱：{profile?.officialEvidence?.verifiedEmail}。打开页面后先核对当前登录邮箱；已保存的官方入口不会切换登录账号。</p><dl className="quota-detail-list"><div><dt>核验时间</dt><dd>{stamp(locator.verifiedAt)}</dd></div><div><dt>浏览器</dt><dd>{locator.browser?{iab:'应用内浏览器',chrome:'Chrome',edge:'Edge'}[locator.browser]:'暂未记录'}</dd></div><div><dt>官方入口</dt><dd>已保存额度与账号页面</dd></div></dl></details>}
      <details className="quota-more-details"><summary>更多账号信息</summary><dl className="quota-detail-list"><div><dt>会员开始时间</dt><dd>{stamp(profile?.subscription?.activeFrom)}</dd></div><div><dt>会员信息核验时间</dt><dd>{stamp(billing?.observedAt||profile?.subscription?.checkedAt)}</dd></div><div><dt>额度读取时间</dt><dd>{stamp(officialFieldStamp(profile??undefined,'windows')||profile?.observedAt)}</dd></div><div><dt>最近登录记录</dt><dd>{stamp(lastSeen)}</dd></div><div><dt>累计 Token</dt><dd>{total===null?'暂无记录':total.toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</dd></div></dl></details>
    </>}
    {tab==='resets'&&<>
      <div className="quota-plan-summary"><div><small>可用重置卡</small><strong>{reset?`${reset.availableCount} 张`:'尚未查询'}</strong></div><span>{resetEvidenceAt?`官方页面核验 · ${stamp(resetEvidenceAt)}`:reset?stamp(profile?.observedAt):'请登录此账号查询'}</span></div>
      {canManage?<><button className="google-quota-refresh" disabled={autoQuery.saving} onClick={queryQuota}><RefreshCw size={15} className={autoQuery.saving?'quota-spinning':''}/>{autoQuery.saving?'正在提交…':'查询此账号官网额度与重置卡'}</button><p className="quota-dialog-note" role="status">{autoQuery.error||accountQueryLabel(autoQuery.queries.find(q=>q.email===email||q.verified_email===email))}</p></>:<a className="google-quota-refresh" href="/signin-with-chatgpt?return_to=%2F%23tokens" target="_top">登录网站管理账号后查询</a>}
      {reset?.credits?.length?<div className="quota-credit-list">{reset.credits.map((c,i)=><article key={i}><div><strong>{c.title||`重置卡 ${i+1}`}</strong><span>{c.expiresAt&&c.expiresAt*1000<=now?'已到期':c.status==='available'?(resetEvidenceAt?'可用（核验时）':'可用'):c.status==='redeemed'?'已使用':c.status==='redeeming'?'使用中':'状态暂未提供'}</span></div>{c.description&&<p>{c.description}</p>}<dl><div><dt>到期时间</dt><dd>{c.expiresAt?stamp(c.expiresAt):c.expiresDateLabel||(c.noExpiry?'无固定到期时间':'暂未提供')}</dd></div><div><dt>剩余时间</dt><dd>{expiry(c.expiresAt,now,c.noExpiry,c.expiresDateLabel)}</dd></div><div><dt>发放时间</dt><dd>{stamp(c.grantedAt)}</dd></div>{c.resetType&&<div><dt>重置类型</dt><dd>{c.resetType==='codexRateLimits'?'Codex 额度重置':c.resetType==='unknown'?'未知':c.resetType}</dd></div>}</dl></article>)}</div>:<p className="quota-history-empty">{reset?(reset.availableCount===0?'该账号本次查询没有可用重置卡。':'接口暂未返回逐张明细。'):'在这台电脑登录此账号后，会自动查询重置卡数量与有效期。'}</p>}
      {resetHistory&&<><div className="quota-history-heading"><strong>官方重置历史</strong><span>{resetHistory.value.length} 条</span></div><p className="quota-dialog-note">官方页面核验于 {stamp(resetHistory.observedAt)}。获得、使用事件按实际时间展示。</p><div className="quota-history-table"><table><thead><tr><th>发生时间</th><th>事件</th></tr></thead><tbody>{[...resetHistory.value].sort((a,b)=>b.occurredAt.localeCompare(a.occurredAt)).map(entry=><tr key={`${entry.kind}:${entry.occurredAt}`}><td>{stamp(entry.occurredAt)}</td><td>{entry.kind==='granted'?'获得重置卡':'使用重置卡'}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div></>}
      <p className="quota-dialog-note">重置卡、额外额度余额和付费即时重置分别展示。官方提供的付费即时重置会立即生效，不会存入重置卡数量。<a href="https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001507-paid-weekly-work-and-codex-rate-limit-resets" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">查看官方说明</a></p><a className="quota-billing-primary" href={locator?.usageUrl||'https://chatgpt.com/settings/usage?tab=overview'} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">前往官方查询重置选项<ArrowUpRight size={16}/></a>
    </>}
    {tab==='history'&&<>
      <div className="quota-history-heading"><strong>历史额度记录</strong><span>{entries.length} 条</span></div><p className="quota-dialog-note">每次官网查询单独保存；部分读取只记录实际取得的字段。电脑离线、账号退出或未能读取的时段没有额度记录。</p>
      {entries.length?<div className="quota-history-table"><table><thead><tr><th>读取时间 / 来源</th><th>7 天剩余</th><th>5 小时剩余</th><th>重置卡</th></tr></thead><tbody>{entries.map(p=><tr key={`${p.source}:${p.observedAt}`}><td>{stamp(p.observedAt)}<small>{p.source==='account-api'?'账号查询':p.source==='official-page'?'官方页面核验':'本机历史记录'} · {plan(p.planType)}</small><small>周重置：{stamp(weeklyWindow(p)?.resetsAt)}</small></td><td>{percentage(p,10080)}</td><td>{percentage(p,300)}</td><td>{p.resetCredits?.availableCount??'—'}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div>:<p className="quota-history-empty">暂无可确认归属的额度记录，登录此账号后开始保存。</p>}
    </>}
    {tab==='mail'&&<GmailCodes key={email} email={email} canManage={canManage}/>}
    {tab==='auth'&&<AuthenticatorCodes key={email} email={email} canManage={canManage}/>}
    </div>
    <div className="quota-detail-footer"><button onClick={download} className="quota-export"><Download size={15}/>下载账号记录</button>{total!==null&&<button onClick={onStatistics}>每日 Token 统计<ArrowUpRight size={15}/></button>}</div><p className="quota-dialog-note">下载文件包含此账号的完整邮箱、会员信息与历史额度。所有时间为 UTC+8。</p>
  </>;
}



===== FILE: app/account-google-tools.tsx =====
"use client";
import {useEffect,useState,useRef} from 'react';
import {Copy,LockKeyhole,Mail,RefreshCw,ShieldCheck} from 'lucide-react';
import {parseTotp,totp,encryptTotp,decryptTotp,type TotpConfig} from '@/lib/totp';
import {parseAuthenticatorImport,readAuthenticatorQr,type AuthenticatorImport} from '@/lib/authenticator-import';
type Message={id:string;subject:string;from:string;receivedAt:string;codes:string[]};
type GmailReply={error?:string;connected?:boolean;messages?:Message[];checkedAt?:string};
const unlocked=new Map<string,TotpConfig>();
const storageKey=(email:string)=>`codex-pulse:totp-v1:${email.toLowerCase()}`;
const date=(stamp:string)=>new Date(stamp).toLocaleString('zh-CN',{timeZone:'Asia/Taipei',month:'numeric',day:'numeric',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit',hour12:false});
export const googleAccountUrl=(email:string)=>`https://myaccount.google.com/?authuser=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`;
export const gmailUrl=(email:string)=>`https://mail.google.com/mail/u/?authuser=${encodeURIComponent(email)}#inbox`;
export const appPasswordsUrl=(email:string)=>`https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords?authuser=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`;
export async function copyCode(code:string){if(!navigator.clipboard)throw new Error('当前浏览器无法复制，请长按验证码复制。');await navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);}

function PrivateLogin(){return <div className="google-private-login"><LockKeyhole size={22}/><p>请使用网站管理账号登录后，连接邮箱或查看二次认证。</p><a className="quota-submit" href="/signin-with-chatgpt?return_to=%2F%23tokens" target="_top">使用网站管理账号登录</a></div>;}

export function GmailCodes({email,canManage}:{email:string;canManage:boolean}){
  const [connected,setConnected]=useState(false),[checked,setChecked]=useState(false),[messages,setMessages]=useState<Message[]>([]),[checkedAt,setCheckedAt]=useState(''),[password,setPassword]=useState(''),[connecting,setConnecting]=useState(false),[busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState(''),[copied,setCopied]=useState(''),[now,setNow]=useState(Date.now());
  const sequence=useRef(0),connectionVersion=useRef(0);
  const endpoint=(action:string)=>`/api/local-apps/identity/${action}?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`;
  useEffect(()=>{const version=++connectionVersion.current;setChecked(false);setConnected(false);setMessages([]);setPassword('');setError('');setConnecting(false);const abort=new AbortController();if(canManage)fetch(endpoint('status'),{cache:'no-store',signal:abort.signal}).then(async r=>{const b=await r.json() as GmailReply;if(version!==connectionVersion.current||abort.signal.aborted)return;if(!r.ok)throw new Error(b.error||'连接状态暂时无法读取');setConnected(b.connected===true);setChecked(true);}).catch(e=>{if(!abort.signal.aborted&&version===connectionVersion.current){setError(e.message);setChecked(true);}});return()=>{abort.abort();++sequence.current;++connectionVersion.current;};},[email,canManage]);
  useEffect(()=>{if(!canManage||!connected)return;const abort=new AbortController();let pending=false;const version=connectionVersion.current;async function load(){if(pending||document.hidden)return;pending=true;const current=++sequence.current;setBusy(true);try{const r=await fetch(endpoint('gmail-codes'),{cache:'no-store',signal:abort.signal}),b=await r.json() as GmailReply;if(!r.ok)throw new Error(b.error||'读取 Gmail 失败');if(current!==sequence.current||version!==connectionVersion.current)return;setConnected(b.connected===true);setMessages(b.messages||[]);setCheckedAt(b.checkedAt||'');setError('');}catch(e){if(!abort.signal.aborted&&current===sequence.current&&version===connectionVersion.current){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'读取失败');}}finally{pending=false;if(!abort.signal.aborted&&current===sequence.current)setBusy(false);}}load();const timer=setInterval(load,15000),tick=setInterval(()=>setNow(Date.now()),1000);document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',load);return()=>{abort.abort();clearInterval(timer);clearInterval(tick);document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',load);++sequence.current;};},[email,connected,canManage]);
  async function connect(event:React.FormEvent){event.preventDefault();const version=++connectionVersion.current;setConnecting(true);setError('');try{const r=await fetch(endpoint('gmail-connection'),{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'connect',password})}),b=await r.json() as GmailReply;if(version!==connectionVersion.current)return;if(!r.ok)throw new Error(b.error||'连接失败');setConnected(true);setPassword('');setChecked(true);}catch(e){if(version===connectionVersion.current)setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'连接失败');}finally{if(version===connectionVersion.current)setConnecting(false);}}
  async function disconnect(){const version=connectionVersion.current;setConnecting(true);try{const r=await fetch(endpoint('gmail-connection'),{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'disconnect'})}),b=await r.json() as GmailReply;if(version!==connectionVersion.current)return;if(!r.ok)throw new Error(b.error||'断开失败');++connectionVersion.current;++sequence.current;setConnected(false);setMessages([]);setError('');}catch(e){if(version===connectionVersion.current)setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'断开失败');}finally{if(version===connectionVersion.current||version+1===connectionVersion.current)setConnecting(false);}}
  async function copy(value:string,id:string){try{await copyCode(value);setCopied(id);setTimeout(()=>setCopied(''),2000);}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'复制失败');}}
  if(!canManage)return <PrivateLogin/>;
  return <div className="google-tool-panel"><div className="google-tool-heading"><Mail size={20}/><div><strong>Gmail 验证码</strong><small>{connected?'每 15 秒检查一次最近 15 分钟的验证码邮件':'此邮箱尚未连接自动收码'}</small></div><a href={gmailUrl(email)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">打开 Gmail</a></div>
    <p className="quota-dialog-note">{email} · 请在 Google 页面核对右上角登录邮箱。</p>
    {error&&<p className="quota-error" role="status">{error}</p>}
    {!checked?<p className="google-empty">正在读取连接状态…</p>:!connected?<form className="google-connection-form" onSubmit={connect}><p>连接后可在这里直接查收、复制验证码。使用 Google 为此邮箱生成的应用专用密码，不要输入 Google 登录密码。</p><a href={appPasswordsUrl(email)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">查看或新建应用专用密码</a><label>Gmail 应用专用密码<input type="password" required autoComplete="off" value={password} onChange={e=>setPassword(e.target.value)} maxLength={24} placeholder="Google 生成的 16 位密码"/></label><p className="quota-dialog-note">连接密码会加密保存在原电脑。邮箱只读取验证码候选邮件，电脑需保持开机联网。</p><button className="quota-submit" disabled={connecting}>{connecting?'正在验证连接…':'连接 Gmail 自动收码'}</button></form>:<>
      <div className="google-read-status"><span>{busy?<><RefreshCw size={14} className="quota-spinning"/>正在检查新邮件</>:checkedAt?`上次读取：${date(checkedAt)}`:'等待首次读取'}</span><button disabled={connecting} onClick={disconnect}>断开本机连接</button></div>
      {messages.filter(m=>now-Date.parse(m.receivedAt)<=15*60000).length?<div className="google-mail-list">{messages.filter(m=>now-Date.parse(m.receivedAt)<=15*60000).map(message=><article key={message.id}><strong>{message.subject}</strong><small>{message.from}<br/>{date(message.receivedAt)}</small><div>{message.codes.map(code=><button key={code} className="google-copy-code" onClick={()=>copy(code,message.id+code)}><span>{code}</span><Copy size={15}/><small>{copied===message.id+code?'已复制':'复制'}</small></button>)}</div></article>)}</div>:<p className="google-empty">{busy?'正在读取最近邮件…':'最近 15 分钟没有识别到验证码邮件。新邮件到达后会自动出现。'}</p>}
      <p className="quota-dialog-note">显示的是候选验证码，请核对邮件来源和时间。未更改邮件已读状态，也不会发送邮件。</p>
    </>}
  </div>;
}

export function AuthenticatorCodes({email,canManage}:{email:string;canManage:boolean}){
  const [config,setConfig]=useState<TotpConfig|null>(null),[stored,setStored]=useState(false),[input,setInput]=useState(''),[password,setPassword]=useState(''),[confirm,setConfirm]=useState(''),[code,setCode]=useState(''),[until,setUntil]=useState(0),[now,setNow]=useState(Date.now()),[error,setError]=useState(''),[busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[copied,setCopied]=useState(false),[removing,setRemoving]=useState(false),[imported,setImported]=useState<AuthenticatorImport|null>(null),[choice,setChoice]=useState(0),[mapped,setMapped]=useState(false);
  const epoch=useRef(0);
  useEffect(()=>{++epoch.current;if(!canManage)unlocked.clear();setConfig(canManage?unlocked.get(email)||null:null);setInput('');setPassword('');setConfirm('');setCode('');setError('');setBusy(false);setImported(null);setMapped(false);setRemoving(false);try{setStored(!!localStorage.getItem(storageKey(email)));}catch{setStored(false);}return()=>{++epoch.current;};},[email,canManage]);
  useEffect(()=>{if(!config||!canManage)return;let active=true,sequence=0;async function refresh(){const current=++sequence;setNow(Date.now());if(document.hidden){setCode('');return;}try{const result=await totp(config!);if(active&&current===sequence&&!document.hidden){setCode(result.validUntil>Date.now()?result.code:'');setUntil(result.validUntil);}}catch{if(active&&current===sequence)setError('无法生成此二次认证码，请重新导入。');}}refresh();const timer=setInterval(refresh,1000);document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',refresh);return()=>{active=false;++sequence;clearInterval(timer);document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',refresh);};},[config,canManage]);
  async function save(event:React.FormEvent){event.preventDefault();const current=++epoch.current;setError('');setBusy(true);try{if(password!==confirm)throw new Error('两次解锁密码不一致。');if(imported&&!mapped)throw new Error('请确认所选认证条目对应此账号。');const next=imported?imported.entries[choice]:parseTotp(input,email),cipher=await encryptTotp(next,password,email);if(current!==epoch.current)return;localStorage.setItem(storageKey(email),JSON.stringify(cipher));unlocked.set(email,next);setConfig(next);setStored(true);setInput('');setPassword('');setConfirm('');setImported(null);setMapped(false);}catch(e){if(current===epoch.current)setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'保存失败');}finally{if(current===epoch.current)setBusy(false);}}
  async function unlock(event:React.FormEvent){event.preventDefault();const current=++epoch.current;setError('');setBusy(true);try{const next=await decryptTotp(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey(email))||'null'),password,email);if(current!==epoch.current)return;unlocked.set(email,next);setConfig(next);setPassword('');}catch(e){if(current===epoch.current)setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'解锁失败');}finally{if(current===epoch.current)setBusy(false);}}
  function lock(){++epoch.current;unlocked.delete(email);setConfig(null);setCode('');setCopied(false);setBusy(false);}
  function remove(){try{localStorage.removeItem(storageKey(email));lock();setStored(false);setRemoving(false);}catch{setError('当前浏览器无法移除保存的数据。');}}
  async function copy(){if(!config)return;const current=epoch.current;try{let result=await totp(config);if(result.validUntil<=Date.now())result=await totp(config);if(current!==epoch.current)return;if(result.validUntil<=Date.now())throw new Error('验证码刚好到期，请重新复制。');await copyCode(result.code);if(current!==epoch.current)return;setCode(result.code);setUntil(result.validUntil);setCopied(true);setTimeout(()=>{if(current===epoch.current)setCopied(false);},1500);}catch(e){if(current===epoch.current)setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'复制失败');}}
  async function importQr(file:File){const current=++epoch.current;setBusy(true);setError('');try{const result=await readAuthenticatorQr(file,email);if(current!==epoch.current)return;setImported(result);setChoice(0);setMapped(false);setInput('');}catch(e){if(current===epoch.current)setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'二维码读取失败');}finally{if(current===epoch.current)setBusy(false);}}
  function importLink(){try{setImported(parseAuthenticatorImport(input,email));setChoice(0);setMapped(false);setInput('');setError('');}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'无法识别导出链接');}}
  if(!canManage)return <PrivateLogin/>;
  return <div className="google-tool-panel"><div className="google-tool-heading"><ShieldCheck size={20}/><div><strong>Google Authenticator</strong><small>兼容六位 TOTP 时间验证码</small></div></div><p className="quota-dialog-note">导入此账号的原始二次认证密钥后，可在这里实时查看、复制验证码。Google 登录不会自动取得 Authenticator 中的密钥。</p>
    {error&&<p className="quota-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    {config?<><div className="google-auth-display"><small>{config.issuer} · {config.label}</small><strong aria-label="当前六位二次认证码">{now<until&&code?code:'······'}</strong><div><span>{Math.max(0,Math.ceil((until-now)/1000))} 秒后更新</span><button className="google-copy-code" disabled={!code||now>=until} onClick={copy}><Copy size={16}/>{copied?'已复制':'复制当前验证码'}</button></div><progress max={config.period} value={Math.max(0,(until-now)/1000)} aria-label="验证码剩余时间"/></div><button className="google-subtle" onClick={lock}>锁定本浏览器认证码</button></>:stored?<form className="google-connection-form" onSubmit={unlock}><label>本浏览器解锁密码<input type="password" autoComplete="off" value={password} onChange={e=>setPassword(e.target.value)} required/></label><button className="quota-submit" disabled={busy}>{busy?'正在解锁…':'解锁并开始自动刷新'}</button></form>:<form className="google-connection-form" onSubmit={save}>
      {!imported?<><label>二次认证密钥或 otpauth 链接<input type="password" autoComplete="off" value={input} onChange={e=>setInput(e.target.value)} required maxLength={35000} placeholder="Base32 密钥 / otpauth://totp/..."/></label>{input.startsWith('otpauth-migration:')&&<button type="button" onClick={importLink}>读取 Authenticator 导出链接</button>}<label className="google-qr-file">或导入 Authenticator 导出二维码<input type="file" accept="image/*" disabled={busy} onChange={e=>{const file=e.target.files?.[0];e.target.value='';if(file)importQr(file);}}/></label><small>Authenticator → 转移验证码 → 导出验证码，选择对应条目。图片只在浏览器读取。</small></>:<div className="google-import-choice"><label>选择与 {email} 对应的认证条目<select value={choice} onChange={e=>{setChoice(Number(e.target.value));setMapped(false);}}>{imported.entries.map((c,i)=><option key={i} value={i}>{c.issuer} · {c.label}</option>)}</select></label><small>已读取第 {imported.page} / {imported.totalPages} 页。{imported.skipped?`跳过 ${imported.skipped} 个非六位 TOTP 条目。`:''}每次导入一个条目；目标不在这一页时请选择其他二维码。</small><label className="google-mapping-confirm"><input type="checkbox" checked={mapped} onChange={e=>setMapped(e.target.checked)} required/>确认此认证条目对应本网站的 {email}</label><button type="button" onClick={()=>{setImported(null);setMapped(false);}}>重新选择密钥或二维码</button></div>}
      <label>设置本浏览器解锁密码<input type="password" minLength={8} required autoComplete="new-password" value={password} onChange={e=>setPassword(e.target.value)} placeholder="至少 8 个字符"/></label><label>再次输入解锁密码<input type="password" minLength={8} required autoComplete="new-password" value={confirm} onChange={e=>setConfirm(e.target.value)}/></label><p className="quota-dialog-note">密钥加密保存在此浏览器，计算和复制均在本地完成。请自行保管解锁密码。</p><button className="quota-submit" disabled={busy}>{busy?'正在处理…':'导入并开始显示六位码'}</button></form>}
    {stored&&<div className="google-remove-auth">{removing?<><p>移除此浏览器保存的认证密钥？原 Google Authenticator 中的账号会保留。</p><button onClick={remove}>确认移除本机副本</button><button onClick={()=>setRemoving(false)}>取消</button></>:<button onClick={()=>setRemoving(true)}>移除此浏览器的密钥副本</button>}</div>}
  </div>;
}

===== FILE: app/account-overview.tsx =====
"use client";
import {useEffect,useState,useCallback,useRef} from 'react';
import {Eye,EyeOff,RefreshCw,Plus,ChartNoAxesCombined,Search,MoreHorizontal,ArrowUpRight,Mail,ShieldCheck} from 'lucide-react';
import AccountDetails,{type DetailTab} from './account-details';
import {googleAccountUrl} from './account-google-tools';
import {Dialog,DialogContent,DialogTitle,DialogDescription} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {weeklyWindow,remaining,isLive,resetSort,type KnownAccount,type QuotaProfile,type QuotaRegistration} from '@/lib/quota';
import {officialFieldStamp} from '@/lib/quota-evidence';
import {useAccountQueries,accountQueryLabel} from './use-account-queries';

const stamp=(value:string|number|null|undefined)=>value?new Date(typeof value==='number'?value*1000:value).toLocaleString('zh-CN',{timeZone:'Asia/Taipei',year:'numeric',month:'numeric',day:'numeric',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hour12:false}):'暂未提供';
function duration(seconds:number){if(seconds<=0)return '等待重新查询';const minutes=Math.ceil(seconds/60),days=Math.floor(minutes/1440),hours=Math.floor(minutes%1440/60);return `${days?`${days}天`:''}${hours?`${hours}小时`:''}${!days&&!hours?`${minutes}分钟`:''}后重置`;}
function age(value:string,now:number){const seconds=Math.max(0,Math.floor((now-Date.parse(value))/1000));return seconds<60?`${seconds}秒前`:seconds<3600?`${Math.floor(seconds/60)}分钟前`:stamp(value);}
const plan=(value?:string|null)=>value?({pro:'Pro',plus:'Plus',free:'Free',team:'Team',business:'Business',enterprise:'Enterprise'}[value]||value):'套餐待查询';
const mask=(email:string)=>{const [local,domain]=email.split('@');return `${local.length>2?local.slice(0,2):'•'}••••@${domain}`;};
type Props={currentAccountEmail:string|null;accounts:KnownAccount[];profiles:QuotaProfile[];history:QuotaProfile[];refreshToken:number;onRefresh:()=>void;onStatistics:(id?:string)=>void;totals:Record<string,number>};

export default function AccountOverview({currentAccountEmail,accounts,profiles,history,refreshToken,onRefresh,onStatistics,totals}:Props){
  const [registrations,setRegistrations]=useState<QuotaRegistration[]>([]),[canManage,setCanManage]=useState(false),[loading,setLoading]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState('');
  const [query,setQuery]=useState(''),[sort,setSort]=useState('reset'),[privateMode,setPrivateMode]=useState(true),[revealed,setRevealed]=useState<Record<string,boolean>>({}),[now,setNow]=useState(Date.now());
  const [adding,setAdding]=useState(false),[email,setEmail]=useState(''),[name,setName]=useState(''),[saving,setSaving]=useState(false),[formError,setFormError]=useState(''),[detail,setDetail]=useState<string|null>(null),[removing,setRemoving]=useState<string|null>(null),[showRemoved,setShowRemoved]=useState(false);
  const [detailTab,setDetailTab]=useState<DetailTab>('plan');
  const autoQuery=useAccountQueries(canManage,onRefresh);
  function openDetail(email:string,tab:DetailTab='plan'){setDetail(email.toLowerCase());setDetailTab(tab);}
  const loadSequence=useRef(0);
  const load=useCallback(async(signal?:AbortSignal)=>{const sequence=++loadSequence.current;setLoading(true);try{const response=await fetch('/api/accounts',{cache:'no-store',signal});const body=await response.json() as {accounts:QuotaRegistration[];canManage:boolean;error?:string};if(!response.ok)throw new Error(body.error||'账号列表暂时无法读取');if(sequence!==loadSequence.current)return;setRegistrations(body.accounts);setCanManage(body.canManage===true);setError('');}catch(e){if(sequence===loadSequence.current&&!(e instanceof DOMException&&e.name==='AbortError'))setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'连接中断，已保留账号记录');}finally{if(sequence===loadSequence.current&&!signal?.aborted)setLoading(false);}},[]);
  useEffect(()=>{const c=new AbortController();load(c.signal);const timer=setInterval(()=>load(c.signal),60000);return()=>{c.abort();clearInterval(timer);};},[load,refreshToken]);
  useEffect(()=>{const timer=setInterval(()=>setNow(Date.now()),1000);try{setPrivateMode(localStorage.getItem('codex-pulse:quota-privacy')!=='show');}catch{}return()=>clearInterval(timer);},[]);
  const all=new Map<string,{email:string;id?:string;name:string;hidden:boolean;lastSeen?:string;profile?:QuotaProfile}>();
  for(const a of accounts)all.set(a.email.toLowerCase(),{email:a.email,id:a.id,name:a.email.split('@')[0],hidden:false,lastSeen:a.lastSeen});
  for(const p of profiles){const key=p.email.toLowerCase();all.set(key,{...(all.get(key)||{email:p.email,name:p.email.split('@')[0],hidden:false}),profile:p});}
  for(const r of registrations){const key=r.email.toLowerCase(),a=all.get(key);all.set(key,{...(a||{email:r.email,name:r.email.split('@')[0]}),name:r.name||a?.name||r.email.split('@')[0],hidden:!!r.hidden});}
  const shown=[...all.values()].filter(a=>!a.hidden),removed=[...all.values()].filter(a=>a.hidden),visible=shown.filter(a=>`${a.email} ${a.name}`.toLowerCase().includes(query.trim().toLowerCase())).sort((a,b)=>sort==='name'?a.email.localeCompare(b.email):sort==='remaining'?(remaining(weeklyWindow(a.profile))??Infinity)-(remaining(weeklyWindow(b.profile))??Infinity):resetSort(weeklyWindow(a.profile),weeklyWindow(b.profile))||a.email.localeCompare(b.email));
  const selected=detail?all.get(detail):undefined;
  async function mutate(action:string,target:string,label=''){setSaving(true);setFormError('');try{const response=await fetch('/api/accounts',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action,email:target,name:label})});const body=await response.json() as {ok?:boolean;error?:string};if(!response.ok)throw new Error(body.error||'保存失败');++loadSequence.current;setRegistrations(previous=>[...previous.filter(r=>r.email!==target.toLowerCase()),{email:target.toLowerCase(),name:action==='add'?label:previous.find(r=>r.email===target.toLowerCase())?.name||'',hidden:action==='hide'?1:0}]);await load();setAdding(false);setRemoving(null);setEmail('');setName('');}catch(e){setFormError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'保存失败，请重试');}finally{setSaving(false);}}
  function refresh(){if(canManage)void autoQuery.request(null);else onRefresh();}
  function togglePrivacy(){setPrivateMode(value=>{try{localStorage.setItem('codex-pulse:quota-privacy',value?'show':'hide');}catch{}return !value;});setRevealed({});}
  const dateOnly=(value?:string|null)=>value?new Date(value).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN',{timeZone:'Asia/Taipei'}):'暂未提供';
  return <section className="quota-overview" aria-label="Codex 账号额度总览">
    <header className="quota-header"><div className="quota-heading"><h2>Codex 额度总览</h2><span>{shown.length} 个账号 · 按实际核验时间保存</span></div><div className="quota-actions"><button aria-label={privateMode?'显示全部邮箱':'隐藏全部邮箱'} title={privateMode?'显示全部邮箱':'隐藏全部邮箱'} onClick={togglePrivacy}>{privateMode?<EyeOff size={18}/>:<Eye size={18}/>}</button><button aria-label="查询 Edge 当前账号" title={canManage?'提交 Edge 当前账号官网查询':'刷新已保存信息'} disabled={loading||autoQuery.saving} onClick={refresh}><RefreshCw size={18} className={loading||autoQuery.saving?'quota-spinning':''}/></button><button aria-label="管理已移除账号" title="管理已移除账号" aria-expanded={showRemoved} onClick={()=>setShowRemoved(v=>!v)}><MoreHorizontal size={20}/></button><button className="quota-add" onClick={()=>{setAdding(true);setFormError('');}}><Plus size={17}/>添加账号</button></div></header>
    {canManage&&<div className="quota-auto-query"><label><input type="checkbox" checked={!!autoQuery.control?.enabled} disabled={autoQuery.saving||!autoQuery.control} onChange={e=>void autoQuery.configure(e.target.checked)}/>自动记录 Edge 已登录账号</label><span>{autoQuery.workerOnline?'后台最近检查过':'等待后台连接'} · {accountQueryLabel(autoQuery.queries[0])}</span><small>连接有效时每 5 分钟核对；查询成功后自动保存额度、重置卡和会员日期。登录失效时保留旧记录。</small>{autoQuery.error&&<p role="status">{autoQuery.error}</p>}</div>}
    <div className="quota-toolbar"><span>账号总览（{shown.length}）</span><label className="quota-search"><Search size={15}/><input aria-label="查询账号" placeholder="查询邮箱或账号名" value={query} onChange={e=>setQuery(e.target.value)}/></label><button className="quota-text-button" onClick={()=>onStatistics()}>每日 Token 统计<ArrowUpRight size={14}/></button><label className="quota-sort"><span>排序</span><select aria-label="账号排序" value={sort} onChange={e=>setSort(e.target.value)}><option value="reset">重置时间：从早到晚</option><option value="remaining">剩余额度：从少到多</option><option value="name">账号名称</option></select></label></div>
    {error&&<p className="quota-message" role="status">{error}。已同步的账号仍可查看。</p>}
    {showRemoved&&<div className="quota-removed"><strong>已移除账号（{removed.length}）</strong>{removed.length?removed.map(a=><div key={a.email}><span>{privateMode?mask(a.email):a.email}</span><button disabled={!canManage||saving} onClick={()=>mutate('restore',a.email)}>恢复显示</button></div>):<p>暂无已移除的账号。</p>}</div>}
    <div className="quota-grid">{visible.map(a=>{const p=a.profile,w=weeklyWindow(p),left=remaining(w),live=isLive(p,now,currentAccountEmail),expired=!!w?.resetsAt&&w.resetsAt*1000<=now,reveal=revealed[a.email]??!privateMode,until=p?.subscription?.activeUntil,displayName=!reveal&&a.name===a.email.split('@')[0]?mask(a.email).split('@')[0]:a.name,nearExpiry=!!until&&Date.parse(until)-now<7*86400000;return <article className="quota-card" key={a.email}>
      <div className="quota-card-top"><div className="quota-identity"><button className="quota-account-name" onClick={()=>openDetail(a.email)}>{displayName}</button><span className="quota-email">{reveal?a.email:mask(a.email)}</span></div><div className="quota-card-tools"><button aria-label={`查询 ${displayName} 的官网信息`} title="查询此邮箱在 Edge 的官网信息" disabled={loading||autoQuery.saving} onClick={()=>canManage?void autoQuery.request(a.email):onRefresh()}><RefreshCw size={15}/></button><button aria-label={`${reveal?'隐藏':'显示'} ${displayName} 的邮箱`} onClick={()=>setRevealed(v=>({...v,[a.email]:!reveal}))}>{reveal?<Eye size={16}/>:<EyeOff size={16}/>}</button><button className="quota-plan" title="查询套餐与充值" onClick={()=>openDetail(a.email)}>{plan(p?.planType)}</button></div></div>
      {canManage&&autoQuery.queries.some(q=>q.email===a.email||q.verified_email===a.email)&&<p className="quota-query-state" role="status">{accountQueryLabel(autoQuery.queries.find(q=>q.email===a.email||q.verified_email===a.email))}</p>}
      <div className="quota-status"><span className={live?'quota-live':''}>{officialFieldStamp(p,'windows')?'官方页面核验额度':live?'当前登录 · 实时额度':p?'历史额度 · 非实时':'待查询额度'}</span>{p&&<span>读取于 {stamp(officialFieldStamp(p,'windows')||p.observedAt)}</span>}</div>
      <div className="quota-window-row"><span>7天额度</span><span>{left===null?'暂未提供':`${left.toFixed(left%1?1:0)}% 剩余`}{w?.resetsAt?` · ${duration(w.resetsAt-now/1000)}（${stamp(w.resetsAt)}）`:''}</span></div>
      <div className={`quota-progress ${left===null?'quota-unknown':''}`} role="progressbar" aria-label={`${displayName} 七天剩余额度`} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuenow={left??undefined} aria-valuetext={left===null?'暂未提供':`${left}% 剩余${live&&!expired?'':'，上次读取值'}`}><span style={{width:`${left??0}%`,background:left!==null&&left<=10?'#ee5265':left!==null&&left<=25?'#f6a21a':'#19bc89'}}/></div>
      <button className="quota-reset" title="查看重置卡明细" onClick={()=>openDetail(a.email,'resets')}>重置卡：{p?.resetCredits?`${p.resetCredits.availableCount} 张可用`:'尚未查询'}{officialFieldStamp(p,'resetCredits')?' · 官方核验':''} <ArrowUpRight size={13}/></button>
      <div className="quota-card-meta"><span>最近更新：{p?age(p.officialEvidence&&p.officialEvidence.observedAt>p.observedAt?p.officialEvidence.observedAt:p.observedAt,now):'等待登录查询'}</span>{p?.officialEvidence?.billing?<span>{p.officialEvidence.billing.value.autoRenew?'自动续订':p.officialEvidence.billing.value.periodEndDate?'会员到期':'续订日期'}：{(p.officialEvidence.billing.value.autoRenew?p.officialEvidence.billing.value.renewalDate:p.officialEvidence.billing.value.periodEndDate||p.officialEvidence.billing.value.renewalDate)?.replaceAll('-','/')}</span>:<span className={nearExpiry?'quota-expiring':''}>会员到期：{dateOnly(until)}</span>}</div>
      <div className="quota-card-bottom"><div className="quota-card-links"><button className="quota-details-link" onClick={()=>openDetail(a.email)}>套餐查询</button><button className="quota-details-link" onClick={()=>openDetail(a.email,'history')}>历史额度</button></div><div><button className="quota-remove" onClick={()=>{setRemoving(a.email);setFormError('');}}>移除</button><button className="quota-chart" aria-label={`查看 ${displayName} 的每日 Token 统计`} title="每日 Token 统计" disabled={!a.id} onClick={()=>onStatistics(a.id)}><ChartNoAxesCombined size={17}/></button></div></div>
      <div className="quota-google-links"><a href={googleAccountUrl(a.email)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Google 账号<ArrowUpRight size={13}/></a><button onClick={()=>openDetail(a.email,'mail')}><Mail size={14}/>Gmail 验证码</button><button onClick={()=>openDetail(a.email,'auth')}><ShieldCheck size={14}/>二次认证</button></div>
    </article>;})}</div>
    {!visible.length&&<p className="quota-empty">{query?'没有找到匹配的账号。':'暂无账号，添加邮箱或在这台电脑登录 Codex 后会自动出现。'}</p>}
    <p className="quota-footnote">后台连接有效时定时核对 Edge 官网完整邮箱，并按邮箱保存查询结果。登录或切换账号会在下一次核对时发现；电脑离线、连接中断或退出登录时显示最后核验记录。所有时间为 UTC+8。</p>
    <Dialog open={adding} onOpenChange={setAdding}><DialogContent className="quota-dialog"><DialogTitle>添加账号</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>添加邮箱后会出现在额度总览。在这台电脑登录该 Codex 账号后，将自动读取它的额度。</DialogDescription>{canManage?<form onSubmit={e=>{e.preventDefault();mutate('add',email,name);}}><label>账号邮箱<input autoFocus required type="email" maxLength={254} value={email} onChange={e=>setEmail(e.target.value)} placeholder="name@example.com"/></label><label>账号名称（可选）<input maxLength={60} value={name} onChange={e=>setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="方便识别的名称"/></label>{formError&&<p className="quota-error" role="alert">{formError}</p>}<button className="quota-submit" disabled={saving}>{saving?'正在保存…':'添加账号'}</button></form>:<a className="quota-submit" href="/signin-with-chatgpt?return_to=%2F%23tokens" target="_top">使用网站管理账号登录</a>}</DialogContent></Dialog>
    <Dialog open={!!removing} onOpenChange={value=>{if(!value)setRemoving(null);}}><DialogContent className="quota-dialog"><DialogTitle>移除账号卡片</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>将 {privateMode&&removing?mask(removing):removing} 从额度总览移除。Token 历史记录会保留，可通过右上角菜单恢复卡片。</DialogDescription>{formError&&<p className="quota-error" role="alert">{formError}</p>}{canManage?<button className="quota-submit quota-danger" disabled={saving} onClick={()=>removing&&mutate('hide',removing)}>{saving?'正在保存…':'确认移除'}</button>:<a className="quota-submit" href="/signin-with-chatgpt?return_to=%2F%23tokens" target="_top">使用网站管理账号登录</a>}</DialogContent></Dialog>
    <Dialog open={!!selected} onOpenChange={value=>{if(!value)setDetail(null);}}><DialogContent className="quota-dialog quota-detail-dialog"><DialogTitle>账号信息</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>{selected&&((revealed[selected.email]??!privateMode)?selected.email:mask(selected.email))}{selected&&<button className="quota-reveal-detail" onClick={()=>setRevealed(v=>({...v,[selected.email]:!(v[selected.email]??!privateMode)}))}>{(revealed[selected.email]??!privateMode)?'隐藏邮箱':'显示邮箱'}</button>}</DialogDescription>{selected&&<AccountDetails key={selected.email} email={selected.email} profile={selected.profile} history={history} lastSeen={selected.lastSeen} total={selected.id?(totals[selected.id]||0):null} currentEmail={currentAccountEmail} now={now} tab={detailTab} onTab={setDetailTab} canManage={canManage} onRefresh={onRefresh} onStatistics={()=>{onStatistics(selected.id);setDetail(null);}}/>}</DialogContent></Dialog>
  </section>;
}



===== FILE: app/activity-center.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Activity, ArrowUpRight, BookOpen, ChevronRight, Clock3, ExternalLink, FolderHeart, Globe, Home, Link2, LockKeyhole, Monitor, Play, RefreshCw, Settings2, Sparkles, WifiOff } from "lucide-react";

type BridgeStatus = { canManage: boolean; connected: boolean; lastSeen: string | null; label: string };
const modules = [
  { id: "overview", group: "活动记录", label: "总览", description: "今天发生的事，一眼回顾。", path: "x-local-capture-v7/index.html#overview", icon: Home },
  { id: "timeline", group: "活动记录", label: "全局时间轴", description: "把阅读、观看与收藏，放回同一条时间线。", path: "x-local-capture-v7/global-timeline.html", icon: Clock3 },
  { id: "x", group: "活动记录", label: "X 行为", description: "查找在 X 上留下的浏览与互动记录。", path: "x-local-capture-v7/index.html#timeline", icon: Activity },
  { id: "watch", group: "活动记录", label: "观看记录", description: "找回看过的内容，接着上次的进度。", path: "x-local-capture-v7/watch.html", icon: Play },
  { id: "links", group: "资料与研究", label: "X 链接收集", description: "为有价值的链接留下标签与用途。", path: "x-link-archive-v1/index.html", icon: Link2 },
  { id: "resources", group: "资料与研究", label: "网页 · 文章 · 代码", description: "保存资源，整理每一份值得再看的资料。", path: "x-local-capture-v7/resources.html", icon: Globe },
  { id: "reading", group: "资料与研究", label: "阅读与研究", description: "继续未读完的内容，记录阅读进度。", path: "x-local-capture-v7/reading.html", icon: BookOpen },
  { id: "library", group: "资料与研究", label: "私人资料库", description: "用收藏夹与标签，整理你的长期积累。", path: "x-local-capture-v7/index.html#special", icon: FolderHeart },
  { id: "interest", group: "偏好与设置", label: "兴趣档案", description: "从真实记录中，回顾自己的关注与兴趣。", path: "x-local-capture-v7/index.html#interest", icon: Sparkles },
  { id: "settings", group: "偏好与设置", label: "隐私设置", description: "管理记录范围、导出与本机历史。", path: "x-local-capture-v7/index.html#settings", icon: Settings2 },
] as const;
const groups = ["活动记录", "资料与研究", "偏好与设置"];
const localRoot = "http://127.0.0.1:5174/";
const date = (value: string) => new Date(value).toLocaleString("zh-CN", { timeZone: "Asia/Taipei", hour12: false });
function embeddedPath(path: string) {
  const [page, hash] = path.split("#");
  return `/mezip/${page}?pulse=1${hash ? `#${hash}` : ""}`;
}

export default function ActivityCenter({ refreshToken = 0 }: { refreshToken?: number }) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string>("timeline");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<BridgeStatus | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [refresh, setRefresh] = useState(0);
  const [frameVersion, setFrameVersion] = useState(0);
  const [frameStarted, setFrameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [frameLoading, setFrameLoading] = useState(true);
  const wasConnected = useRef(false);
  const frame = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement>(null);
  const current = modules.find(module => module.id === selected) || modules[1];

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true, pending = false;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    async function load() {
      if (pending) return;
      pending = true;
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/mezip/status", { cache: "no-store", signal: AbortSignal.any([controller.signal, AbortSignal.timeout(12000)]) });
        if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) {
          if (active) {
            setStatus({ canManage: false, connected: false, lastSeen: null, label: "这台电脑上的 ME.zip" });
            setFrameStarted(false);
            setError("");
            wasConnected.current = false;
          }
          return;
        }
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error("暂时无法确认电脑连接，正在自动重试。");
        const value = await response.json() as BridgeStatus;
        if (!active) return;
        setStatus(value);
        setError("");
        if (!value.canManage) {
          setFrameStarted(false);
          wasConnected.current = false;
          return;
        }
        if (value.connected) {
          if (!wasConnected.current) {
            setFrameLoading(true);
            setFrameVersion(version => version + 1);
          }
          setFrameStarted(true);
        }
        wasConnected.current = value.connected;
      } catch {
        if (active) {
          setError("暂时无法确认电脑连接，正在自动重试。");
          wasConnected.current = false;
        }
      } finally {
        pending = false;
      }
    }
    load();
    const timer = setInterval(load, 10000);
    return () => { active = false; controller.abort(); clearInterval(timer); };
  }, [refresh, refreshToken]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const ready = (event: MessageEvent) => {
      if (event.origin !== window.location.origin || event.source !== frame.current?.contentWindow) return;
      if (event.data?.type === "mezip:pulse-ready") setFrameLoading(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener("message", ready);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("message", ready);
  }, []);

  const online = !!status?.canManage && status.connected && !error;
  const connectionLabel = !status && !error ? "正在连接" : error ? "正在重连" : !status?.canManage ? "私人空间" : online ? "电脑已连接" : "电脑暂时离线";
  function choose(id: string) { if (id !== selected) { setSelected(id); setFrameLoading(true); } }

  return <section className="activity-center">
    <div className="intro activity-intro">
      <div><p className="eyebrow">我的活动记录</p><h1>ME.zip <span>活动空间</span></h1><p className="activity-subtitle">连接这台电脑，继续查看与整理你的真实记录。</p></div>
      <span className="activity-private"><LockKeyhole size={14}/>仅本人可访问</span>
    </div>
    <div className={`activity-connection ${online ? "is-online" : ""}`} role="status">
      <div className="activity-connection-name"><span className="activity-status-dot"/><strong>{connectionLabel}</strong><span>{status?.canManage ? status.label || "这台电脑上的 ME.zip" : "ME.zip 本机服务"}</span></div>
      <div className="activity-connection-detail">{status?.canManage && status.lastSeen && <time dateTime={status.lastSeen}>最近连接 {date(status.lastSeen)}</time>}<button type="button" className="activity-icon-button" aria-label="重新检查 ME.zip 连接" onClick={() => setRefresh(value => value + 1)}><RefreshCw size={15}/></button></div>
    </div>
    {!status && !error ? <div className="activity-gate" role="status"><Monitor size={30}/><h2>正在连接你的活动空间</h2><p>正在确认访问权限与本机服务状态…</p></div> : !status && error ? <div className="activity-gate" role="alert"><WifiOff size={30}/><h2>连接暂时中断</h2><p>{error}</p><button className="library-button" onClick={() => setRefresh(value => value + 1)}><RefreshCw size={15}/>立即重试</button></div> : !status?.canManage ? <div className="activity-gate">
      <span className="activity-gate-symbol"><LockKeyhole size={27}/></span><p className="eyebrow">你的私人空间</p><h2>你的活动记录，只有你能打开。</h2><p>登录这个网站的管理账号后，即可连接这台电脑上的 ME.zip，查看时间轴、阅读进度与私人资料库。</p><a className="library-button primary" href="/signin-with-chatgpt?return_to=%2F%23activity" target="_top">登录并打开<ArrowUpRight size={16}/></a>
    </div> : <>
      <div className="activity-workspace">
        <nav className="activity-module-nav" aria-label="ME.zip 模块">
          {groups.map(group => <div className="activity-module-group" key={group}><p>{group}</p><div>{modules.filter(module => module.group === group).map(module => { const Icon = module.icon; return <button key={module.id} type="button" aria-current={selected === module.id ? "page" : undefined} className={selected === module.id ? "selected" : ""} onClick={() => choose(module.id)}><Icon size={17}/><span>{module.label}</span><ChevronRight size={13} className="activity-nav-chevron"/></button>; })}</div></div>)}
          <div className="activity-nav-note"><Monitor size={17}/><span>电脑开机联网后<br/>会自动恢复连接</span></div>
        </nav>
        <div className="activity-canvas">
          <div className="activity-canvas-header"><div><p>{current.group}</p><h2>{current.label}</h2><span>{current.description}</span></div><a className="activity-open-link" href={`/mezip/${current.path}`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label={`在新页面打开${current.label}`} title="在新页面打开"><ExternalLink size={17}/></a></div>
          <div className="activity-frame-wrap" aria-busy={online && frameLoading}>
            {frameStarted && <iframe ref={frame} key={`${selected}-${frameVersion}`} src={embeddedPath(current.path)} title={`ME.zip · ${current.label}`} loading="lazy" allow="clipboard-write" referrerPolicy="same-origin" onLoad={() => setFrameLoading(false)} className={online ? "" : "activity-frame-unavailable"} tabIndex={online ? 0 : -1}/>}
            {online && frameLoading && <div className="activity-frame-loading" role="status"><RefreshCw size={20}/><span>正在读取{current.label}…</span></div>}
            {!online && <div className="activity-offline" role="status"><WifiOff size={30}/><h3>{error ? "正在重新连接电脑" : "等待这台电脑上线"}</h3><p>{error || "电脑开机并连接网络后，这里会自动恢复。无需重新填写地址或配对。"}</p>{status.lastSeen && <small>最近连接：{date(status.lastSeen)}</small>}<button className="library-button" onClick={() => setRefresh(value => value + 1)}><RefreshCw size={15}/>检查连接</button></div>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="activity-footnote"><p><LockKeyhole size={14}/>这些活动记录仅本人可访问。电脑离线时暂停操作，连接恢复后自动更新。</p><a href={`${localRoot}${current.path}`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">在原电脑打开<ArrowUpRight size={14}/></a></div>
    </>}
  </section>;
}

import {database} from '@/db/raw';
import {isOwner,canWrite,boundedJson,privateHeaders} from '@/lib/website-api';
import {InvalidQuotaEvidence,parseQuotaEvidenceInput,readQuotaEvidence,storeQuotaEvidence} from '@/lib/quota-evidence';

export async function GET(request:Request){
  const origin=request.headers.get('Origin');
  if(!isOwner(request)||(origin&&origin!==new URL(request.url).origin)||request.headers.get('Sec-Fetch-Site')==='cross-site')return Response.json({error:'请使用网站管理账号登录'},{status:403,headers:privateHeaders});
  try{return Response.json({evidence:await readQuotaEvidence(database())},{headers:privateHeaders});}
  catch{return Response.json({error:'官方核验记录暂时无法读取'},{status:503,headers:privateHeaders});}
}
export async function POST(request:Request){
  if(!canWrite(request))return Response.json({error:'请使用网站管理账号在本站保存核验记录'},{status:403,headers:privateHeaders});
  try{
    let input:unknown;try{input=await boundedJson(request,24000);}catch{return Response.json({error:'核验记录格式无效或超出大小限制'},{status:400,headers:privateHeaders});}
    const evidence=parseQuotaEvidenceInput(input),result=await storeQuotaEvidence(database(),evidence);
    if(result==='conflict')return Response.json({error:'记录正在更新，请重试'},{status:409,headers:privateHeaders});
    return Response.json({ok:true,...(result==='stale'?{ignored:'stale'}:{})},{headers:privateHeaders});
  }catch(error){return Response.json({error:error instanceof InvalidQuotaEvidence?'请提供邮箱一致、时间有效的官方核验记录':'核验记录暂时无法保存'},{status:error instanceof InvalidQuotaEvidence?400:503,headers:privateHeaders});}
}

===== FILE: app/api/accounts/route.ts =====
import {database} from '@/db/raw';
import {isOwner,canWrite,boundedJson,privateHeaders} from '@/lib/website-api';
import {accountEmail} from '@/lib/account-label';

export async function GET(request:Request){
  try {
    const rows=await database().prepare('SELECT email,name,hidden FROM quota_accounts ORDER BY email').all();
    return Response.json({accounts:rows.results,canManage:isOwner(request)},{headers:privateHeaders});
  } catch {return Response.json({error:'账号列表暂时无法读取，请稍后重试'},{status:503,headers:privateHeaders});}
}
export async function POST(request:Request){
  if(!canWrite(request))return Response.json({error:'请使用网站管理账号登录后添加或移除账号'},{status:403,headers:privateHeaders});
  try {
    const input=await boundedJson(request,3000),email=accountEmail(input.email)?.toLowerCase();
    if(!email||!['add','hide','restore'].includes(input.action))return Response.json({error:'请输入有效的邮箱地址'},{status:400,headers:privateHeaders});
    const name=typeof input.name==='string'?input.name.trim().slice(0,60):'';
    if(input.action==='add'){
      await database().prepare('INSERT INTO quota_accounts(email,name,hidden,created_at) VALUES(?,?,0,?) ON CONFLICT(email) DO UPDATE SET name=excluded.name,hidden=0').bind(email,name,new Date().toISOString()).run();
    } else {
      await database().prepare('INSERT INTO quota_accounts(email,name,hidden,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(email) DO UPDATE SET hidden=excluded.hidden').bind(email,'',input.action==='hide'?1:0,new Date().toISOString()).run();
    }
    return Response.json({ok:true},{headers:privateHeaders});
  }catch{return Response.json({error:'保存失败，请重试；输入内容已保留'},{status:503,headers:privateHeaders});}
}



===== FILE: app/api/booking/route.ts =====
import { database } from '@/db/raw';
import { boundedJson, isOwner, websiteId } from '@/lib/website-api';
import { bookingFields, bookingReply, notifyBooking, type Booking } from '@/lib/booking';

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  if (!isOwner(request)) return bookingReply({ canManage: false, bookings: [] });
  try {
    const result = await database().prepare(`SELECT ${bookingFields} FROM booking_requests ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 100`).all<Booking>();
    const bookings = result.results;
    // Reconcile only mail already attempted; reading the list never sends new mail.
    await Promise.allSettled(bookings.filter(b => b.notification === 'sending').slice(0, 5).map(async booking => { booking.notification = await notifyBooking(booking); }));
    return bookingReply({ canManage: true, bookings: bookings.map(({id,date,time,name,email,notes,notification,created}) => ({id,date,time,name,email,notes,notification,created})) });
  } catch { return bookingReply({ canManage: true, error: '预约记录暂时无法读取，请稍后刷新。' }, 503); }
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  if (request.headers.get('Origin') !== new URL(request.url).origin) return bookingReply({ ok: false, error: '请从预约页面提交。' }, 403);
  let data;
  try { data = await boundedJson(request, 12000); } catch { return bookingReply({ ok: false, error: '预约内容格式无效或过长。' }, 400); }
  const uuid = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || typeof data.id !== 'string' || !uuid.test(data.id)) return bookingReply({ ok: false, error: '预约编号无效，请重新提交。' }, 400);
  if (['date','time','name','email','notes'].some(field => typeof data[field] !== 'string')) return bookingReply({ ok: false, error: '请完整填写预约资料。' }, 400);
  const { date, time } = data;
  const name = data.name.trim(), email = data.email.trim(), notes = data.notes.trim(), id = data.id.toLowerCase();
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date) || !/^(?:[01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d:[0-5]\d$/.test(time)) return bookingReply({ ok: false, error: '请选择有效的日期和时间。' }, 400);
  const starts = Date.parse(`${date}T${time}+08:00`), ends = starts + 15 * 60000;
  if (!Number.isFinite(starts) || new Date(starts + 8 * 3600000).toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== date || name.length > 120 || email.length > 254 || notes.length > 2000 || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) return bookingReply({ ok: false, error: '请检查日期、联系邮箱及资料长度。' }, 400);
  try {
    const db = database(), fingerprint = await websiteId(JSON.stringify([date,time,name,email,notes]));
    const existing = await db.prepare(`SELECT ${bookingFields} FROM booking_requests WHERE id=?`).bind(id).first<Booking>();
    if (existing) {
      if (existing.fingerprint !== fingerprint) return bookingReply({ ok: false, error: '此预约编号已使用，请重新开始预约。' }, 409);
      return bookingReply({ ok: true, id, saved: true, notification: await notifyBooking(existing, true) });
    }
    if (starts <= Date.now()) return bookingReply({ ok: false, error: '这个时间已经过去，请选择未来的时间。' }, 400);
    const ip = await websiteId(request.headers.get('cf-connecting-ip') || 'local'), created = Date.now();
    // One atomic INSERT prevents overlapping 15-minute bookings and concurrent quota bypass.
    const inserted = await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO booking_requests(id,fingerprint,date,time,name,email,notes,starts,ends,notification,ip_hash,created)
      SELECT ?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'pending',?,?
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM booking_requests WHERE starts<? AND ends>?)
      AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking_requests WHERE ip_hash=? AND created>?)<5
      ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING`).bind(id,fingerprint,date,time,name,email,notes,starts,ends,ip,created,ends,starts,ip,created-15*60000).run();
    const saved = await db.prepare(`SELECT ${bookingFields} FROM booking_requests WHERE id=?`).bind(id).first<Booking>();
    if (!saved) {
      const count = await db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) count FROM booking_requests WHERE ip_hash=? AND created>?').bind(ip,created-15*60000).first<{count:number}>();
      if ((count?.count || 0) >= 5) return bookingReply({ ok: false, error: '预约提交过于频繁，请 15 分钟后再试。' }, 429);
      return bookingReply({ ok: false, error: '这个时间段已有预约，请选择另一个时间。' }, 409);
    }
    if (saved.fingerprint !== fingerprint) return bookingReply({ ok: false, error: '预约编号已用于其他内容。' }, 409);
    const notification = await notifyBooking(saved, !!inserted.meta.changes);
    return bookingReply({ ok: true, id, saved: true, notification }, inserted.meta.changes ? 201 : 200);
  } catch { return bookingReply({ ok: false, error: '暂时无法确认保存结果。请保留页面，使用重新提交核对同一预约。' }, 503); }
}



===== FILE: app/api/compass/media/route.ts =====
import { env } from 'cloudflare:workers';
import { database } from '@/db/raw';
import { compassScope, compassHeaders, compassReply as reply } from '@/lib/compass-auth';
import { cleanPng } from '@/lib/compass-png';
import { uuid } from '@/lib/compass-workspace';
export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export async function GET(request:Request){
  const scope=await compassScope(request);if(!scope)return reply({error:'请登录网站管理账号。'},401);
  const id=new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('id');if(!id||!uuid.test(id))return reply({error:'封面不存在。'},404);
  try{if(!await database().prepare('SELECT id FROM compass_media WHERE scope=? AND id=?').bind(scope,id).first())return reply({error:'封面不存在。'},404);const object=await env.BUCKET?.get(`compass/${scope}/${id}.png`);if(!object)return reply({error:'封面暂时无法读取。'},503);return new Response(object.body,{headers:{...compassHeaders,'Content-Type':'image/png','Content-Security-Policy':"default-src 'none'; sandbox"}});}catch{return reply({error:'封面暂时无法读取。'},503);}
}
export async function POST(request:Request){
  const scope=await compassScope(request);if(!scope)return reply({error:'请登录网站管理账号。'},401);if(request.headers.get('Origin')!==new URL(request.url).origin)return reply({error:'请从本站上传。'},403);
  if(request.headers.get('Content-Type')!=='image/png')return reply({error:'请选择 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP 图片。'},400);
  let image;
  try{const reader=request.body?.getReader();if(!reader)throw new Error();const chunks:Uint8Array[]=[];let size=0;while(true){const {done,value}=await reader.read();if(done)break;size+=value.length;if(size>3_000_000){await reader.cancel();throw new Error();}chunks.push(value);}image=await cleanPng(new Uint8Array(await new Blob(chunks as BlobPart[]).arrayBuffer()));}catch{return reply({error:'图片无效或太大，请换一张图片。'},400);}
  const id=crypto.randomUUID(),key=`compass/${scope}/${id}.png`;
  try{if(!env.BUCKET)throw new Error('Storage unavailable');await env.BUCKET.put(key,image.bytes,{httpMetadata:{contentType:'image/png'}});try{await database().prepare('INSERT INTO compass_media(scope,id,width,height,created) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)').bind(scope,id,image.width,image.height,Date.now()).run();}catch(error){await env.BUCKET.delete(key);throw error;}return reply({id,width:image.width,height:image.height});}catch{return reply({error:'封面未能保存，请重试。原来的封面仍保留。'},503);}
}

const reply=(body:unknown,status=200)=>Response.json(body,{status,headers});
const idPattern=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
async function scopeFor(request:Request){const id=request.headers.get('oai-authenticated-user-id');return id&&isOwner(request)?websiteId('compass:'+id):null;}
export async function GET(request:Request){

  if(!scope)return reply({error:'请登录网站管理账号，查看自己的 Compass 记录。',needsLogin:true},401);
  const date=new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('date');
  if(!validCompassDate(date))return reply({error:'请选择有效日期。'},400);
  try{return reply(await readCompass(scope,date));}catch{return reply({error:'记录暂时无法读取，请重试。'},503);}
}
export async function POST(request:Request){
  const scope=await scopeFor(request);
  if(!scope)return reply({error:'登录状态已变化，请重新登录网站管理账号。',needsLogin:true},401);
  if(request.headers.get('Origin')!==new URL(request.url).origin)return reply({error:'请从本站保存记录。'},403);
  let body;
  try{body=await boundedJson(request,16000);}catch{return reply({error:'记录格式无效或过长。'},400);}
  if(!body||!validCompassDate(body.date))return reply({error:'请选择有效日期。'},400);
  const date=body.date;
  try{
    const db=database();
    if(body.action==='entry'||body.action==='task'){
      if(typeof body.id!=='string'||!idPattern.test(body.id)||typeof body.text!=='string'||!body.text.trim()||body.text.length>4000)return reply({error:'请输入 1–4000 字的记录。'},400);
      const text=body.text.trim(),id=body.id.toLowerCase();
      if(body.action==='entry'){
        if(!Object.hasOwn(compassKinds,body.kind))return reply({error:'记录类型无效。'},400);
        await db.prepare('INSERT INTO compass_entries(scope,id,date,kind,text,created) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(scope,id) DO NOTHING').bind(scope,id,date,body.kind,text,Date.now()).run();
        const saved=await db.prepare('SELECT date,kind,text FROM compass_entries WHERE scope=? AND id=?').bind(scope,id).first<{date:string;kind:string;text:string}>();
        if(!saved||saved.date!==date||saved.kind!==body.kind||saved.text!==text)return reply({error:'这条记录的编号已使用，请修改内容后重试。'},409);
      }else{
        const due=body.due||null;
        if(due!==null&&!validCompassDate(due))return reply({error:'截止日期无效。'},400);
        await db.prepare('INSERT INTO compass_tasks(scope,id,text,due,done,version,created) VALUES(?,?,?,?,0,1,?) ON CONFLICT(scope,id) DO NOTHING').bind(scope,id,text,due,Date.now()).run();
        const saved=await db.prepare('SELECT text,due FROM compass_tasks WHERE scope=? AND id=?').bind(scope,id).first<{text:string;due:string|null}>();
        if(!saved||saved.text!==text||saved.due!==due)return reply({error:'这条任务的编号已使用，请修改内容后重试。'},409);
      }
    }else if(body.action==='toggle'){
      if(typeof body.id!=='string'||!idPattern.test(body.id)||typeof body.done!=='boolean'||!Number.isSafeInteger(body.version)||body.version<1)return reply({error:'任务状态无效。'},400);
      const result=await db.prepare('UPDATE compass_tasks SET done=?,version=version+1 WHERE scope=? AND id=? AND version=?').bind(body.done?1:0,scope,body.id,body.version).run();
      if(!result.meta.changes){const current=await db.prepare('SELECT done FROM compass_tasks WHERE scope=? AND id=?').bind(scope,body.id).first<{done:number}>();if(!current||!!current.done!==body.done)return reply({error:'任务已在另一页面更新，请重新读取。',conflict:true},409);}
    }else if(body.action==='habit'||body.action==='scores'){
      if(!Number.isSafeInteger(body.version)||body.version<0)return reply({error:'记录版本无效。'},400);
      const current=(await readCompass(scope,date)).day;
      let matches=false;
      if(body.action==='habit'){
        if(!Number.isInteger(body.index)||body.index<0||body.index>2||typeof body.value!=='boolean')return reply({error:'习惯格式无效。'},400);
        matches=current.habits[body.index]===body.value;
        current.habits[body.index]=body.value;
      }else{
        if(!Array.isArray(body.scores)||body.scores.length!==6||body.scores.some((v:unknown)=>v!==null&&(!Number.isInteger(v)||Number(v)<1||Number(v)>10)))return reply({error:'每题请选择 1–10 分，或留空。'},400);
        matches=JSON.stringify(current.scores)===JSON.stringify(body.scores);
        current.scores=body.scores;
      }
      if(!matches&&(current.version!==body.version||!await saveCompassDay(scope,date,current,body.version)))return reply({error:'这一天已在另一页面更新。你的输入已保留，请重新读取后核对。',conflict:true},409);
    }else return reply({error:'不支持的操作。'},400);
    return reply(await readCompass(scope,date));
  }catch{return reply({error:'暂时无法确认保存结果，输入已保留。请点击原按钮重试，同一条记录不会重复添加。'},503);}
}



===== FILE: app/api/compass/workspace/route.ts =====
import { database } from '@/db/raw';
import { boundedJson } from '@/lib/website-api';
import { compassScope, compassReply as reply } from '@/lib/compass-auth';
import { defaultConfig, emptyTimer, timerTransition, uuid, validConfig, type Timer, type WorkspaceConfig } from '@/lib/compass-workspace';
export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
async function read(scope:string){
  const db=database();
  const [docs,memories]=await Promise.all([db.prepare('SELECT key,payload,version FROM compass_workspace WHERE scope=?').bind(scope).all<{key:string;payload:string;version:number}>(),db.prepare('SELECT id,text,priority,done,remind_at AS remindAt,notified,version,created FROM compass_memories WHERE scope=? ORDER BY done ASC,created DESC LIMIT 500').bind(scope).all<{id:string;text:string;priority:string;done:number;remindAt:number|null;notified:number;version:number;created:number}>()]);
  const config=docs.results.find(d=>d.key==='config'),timer=docs.results.find(d=>d.key==='timer');
  const [alerts,due]=await Promise.all([db.prepare('SELECT id,text FROM compass_alerts WHERE scope=? AND seen=0 ORDER BY created ASC LIMIT 50').bind(scope).all<{id:string;text:string}>(),db.prepare('SELECT id,text,priority,done,remind_at AS remindAt,notified,version,created FROM compass_memories WHERE scope=? AND done=0 AND notified=0 AND remind_at<=? ORDER BY remind_at ASC LIMIT 50').bind(scope,Date.now()).all()]);
  return {config:config?JSON.parse(config.payload) as WorkspaceConfig:defaultConfig(),configVersion:config?.version||0,timer:timer?{...JSON.parse(timer.payload),version:timer.version} as Timer:emptyTimer(),memories:memories.results.map(m=>({...m,done:!!m.done,notified:!!m.notified})),dueMemories:due.results,alerts:alerts.results,serverNow:Date.now()};
}
async function cas(scope:string,key:string,payload:unknown,version:number){
  if(version===0)return !!(await database().prepare('INSERT INTO compass_workspace(scope,key,payload,version) VALUES(?,?,?,1) ON CONFLICT(scope,key) DO NOTHING').bind(scope,key,JSON.stringify(payload)).run()).meta.changes;
  return !!(await database().prepare('UPDATE compass_workspace SET payload=?,version=version+1 WHERE scope=? AND key=? AND version=?').bind(JSON.stringify(payload),scope,key,version).run()).meta.changes;
}
export async function GET(request:Request){const scope=await compassScope(request);if(!scope)return reply({error:'请登录网站管理账号。',needsLogin:true},401);try{return reply(await read(scope));}catch{return reply({error:'暂时无法读取，请重试。'},503);}}
export async function POST(request:Request){
  const scope=await compassScope(request);if(!scope)return reply({error:'请重新登录网站管理账号。',needsLogin:true},401);
  if(request.headers.get('Origin')!==new URL(request.url).origin)return reply({error:'请从本站操作。'},403);
  let b;try{b=await boundedJson(request,150000);}catch{return reply({error:'内容无效或过长。'},400);}
  if(!b||!Number.isSafeInteger(b.version)||b.version<0)return reply({error:'记录版本无效。'},400);
  try{
    const db=database();let notify=false;
    if(b.action==='config'){
      if(!validConfig(b.config))return reply({error:'请检查板块名称、标签、内容和计时设置。'},400);
      for(const id of [...b.config.sections.map((s:{cover:string|null})=>s.cover),...b.config.portraits])if(id&&!await db.prepare('SELECT id FROM compass_media WHERE scope=? AND id=?').bind(scope,id).first())return reply({error:'图片不存在，请重新上传。'},400);
      if(!await cas(scope,'config',b.config,b.version))return reply({error:'配置已在另一页面更改。草稿已保留，请重新读取后核对。'},409);
    }else if(b.action==='timer'){
      const current=(await read(scope)).timer;
      if(current.version!==b.version)return reply({error:'计时状态已变化，正在重新同步。'},409);
      const next=timerTransition(current,b.command,Date.now(),b);
      if(!next)return reply({error:'当前计时状态不支持此操作。'},400);
      if(b.command==='finish'){
        const results=await db.batch([db.prepare('UPDATE compass_workspace SET payload=?,version=version+1 WHERE scope=? AND key=? AND version=?').bind(JSON.stringify(next),scope,'timer',b.version),db.prepare("INSERT INTO compass_alerts(scope,id,text,seen,created) SELECT ?,?,?,0,? WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM compass_workspace WHERE scope=? AND key='timer' AND version=? AND json_extract(payload,'$.id')=? AND json_extract(payload,'$.status')='finished') ON CONFLICT(scope,id) DO NOTHING").bind(scope,'timer:'+current.id,current.phase==='focus'?'专注完成了，休息一下吧。':'休息结束了，准备好再开始。',Date.now(),scope,b.version+1,current.id)]);
        if(!results[0].meta.changes)return reply({error:'计时状态已在另一页面更新。'},409);
      }else if(!await cas(scope,'timer',next,b.version))return reply({error:'计时状态已在另一页面更新。'},409);
      notify=b.command==='finish';
    }else if(b.action==='memory'){
      if(typeof b.id!=='string'||!uuid.test(b.id)||typeof b.text!=='string'||!b.text.trim()||b.text.length>2000||!['normal','important'].includes(b.priority)||typeof b.done!=='boolean'||!(b.remindAt===null||(Number.isSafeInteger(b.remindAt)&&b.remindAt>0&&b.remindAt<4102444800000)))return reply({error:'请填写有效的重要事项。'},400);
      if(b.version===0){
        const result=await db.prepare('INSERT INTO compass_memories(scope,id,text,priority,done,remind_at,notified,version,created) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,0,1,?) ON CONFLICT(scope,id) DO NOTHING').bind(scope,b.id,b.text.trim(),b.priority,b.done?1:0,b.remindAt,Date.now()).run();
        if(!result.meta.changes){const old=await db.prepare('SELECT text,priority,done,remind_at FROM compass_memories WHERE scope=? AND id=?').bind(scope,b.id).first<{text:string;priority:string;done:number;remind_at:number|null}>();if(!old||old.text!==b.text.trim()||old.priority!==b.priority||!!old.done!==b.done||old.remind_at!==b.remindAt)return reply({error:'事项已更新，请重新读取。'},409);}
      }else if(!(await db.prepare('UPDATE compass_memories SET text=?,priority=?,done=?,notified=CASE WHEN remind_at IS ? THEN notified ELSE 0 END,remind_at=?,version=version+1 WHERE scope=? AND id=? AND version=?').bind(b.text.trim(),b.priority,b.done?1:0,b.remindAt,b.remindAt,scope,b.id,b.version).run()).meta.changes)return reply({error:'事项已在另一页面更新，输入已保留。'},409);
    }else if(b.action==='memory-delete'){
      if(typeof b.id!=='string'||!uuid.test(b.id))return reply({error:'事项编号无效。'},400);
      const results=await db.batch([db.prepare('DELETE FROM compass_alerts WHERE scope=? AND id LIKE ? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM compass_memories WHERE scope=? AND id=? AND version=?)').bind(scope,'memory:'+b.id+':%',scope,b.id,b.version),db.prepare('DELETE FROM compass_memories WHERE scope=? AND id=? AND version=?').bind(scope,b.id,b.version)]);
      if(!results[1].meta.changes)return reply({error:'事项已变化，请重新读取。'},409);
    }else if(b.action==='memory-alert'){
      if(typeof b.id!=='string'||!uuid.test(b.id))return reply({error:'事项编号无效。'},400);
      const results=await db.batch([db.prepare("INSERT INTO compass_alerts(scope,id,text,seen,created) SELECT scope,'memory:'||id||':'||remind_at,'你交代的事：'||text,0,? FROM compass_memories WHERE scope=? AND id=? AND done=0 AND notified=0 AND remind_at<=? AND version=? ON CONFLICT(scope,id) DO NOTHING").bind(Date.now(),scope,b.id,Date.now(),b.version),db.prepare('UPDATE compass_memories SET notified=1 WHERE scope=? AND id=? AND done=0 AND notified=0 AND remind_at<=? AND version=?').bind(scope,b.id,Date.now(),b.version)]);notify=!!results[0].meta.changes;
    }else if(b.action==='ack-alert'){
      if(typeof b.id!=='string'||b.id.length>120)return reply({error:'提醒编号无效。'},400);
      await db.prepare('UPDATE compass_alerts SET seen=1 WHERE scope=? AND id=?').bind(scope,b.id).run();
    }else return reply({error:'不支持此操作。'},400);
    return reply({...await read(scope),notify});
  }catch{return reply({error:'保存暂时失败，输入已保留，请重试。'},503);}
}

/** The existing collector credential can submit verified account evidence; it cannot read private browser locators. */
export async function POST(request:Request){
  const headers={'Cache-Control':'no-store'},key=(env as unknown as Record<string,string>).INGEST_TOKEN;
  if(!key||request.headers.get('Authorization')!==`Bearer ${key}`)return Response.json({error:'Unauthorized'},{status:401,headers});
  try{
    let input:unknown;try{input=await boundedJson(request,24000);}catch{return Response.json({error:'Invalid evidence payload'},{status:400,headers});}
    const evidence=parseQuotaEvidenceInput(input),result=await storeQuotaEvidence(database(),evidence);
    if(result==='conflict')return Response.json({error:'Concurrent evidence update; retry'},{status:409,headers});
    return Response.json({ok:true,...(result==='stale'?{ignored:'stale'}:{})},{headers});
  }catch(error){return Response.json({error:error instanceof InvalidQuotaEvidence?'Invalid official account evidence':'Evidence sync unavailable'},{status:error instanceof InvalidQuotaEvidence?400:503,headers});}
}



===== FILE: app/api/ingest/route.ts =====
import { env } from 'cloudflare:workers';
import { database } from '@/db/raw';
import { InvalidUsageSnapshot, storeUsageSnapshot } from '@/lib/usage-history';

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const key = (env as unknown as Record<string, string>).INGEST_TOKEN;
  if (!key || request.headers.get('Authorization') !== `Bearer ${key}`) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  const headers = { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' };
  try {
    const reader = request.body?.getReader();
    if (!reader) return new Response('No body', { status: 400 });
    let size = 0;
    const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      size += value.byteLength;
      if (size > 1_800_000) { await reader.cancel(); return new Response('Payload too large', { status: 413 }); }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(size);
    let at = 0;
    for (const chunk of chunks) { bytes.set(chunk, at); at += chunk.length; }
    const result = await storeUsageSnapshot(database(), new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));
    if (result === 'incomplete') return Response.json({ error: 'Incomplete usage history; existing records retained', code: 'HISTORY_REGRESSION' }, { status: 409, headers });
    if (result === 'conflict') return Response.json({ error: 'Concurrent update; retry the complete snapshot', code: 'SNAPSHOT_CONFLICT' }, { status: 409, headers });
    return Response.json({ ok: true, ...(result === 'stale' ? { ignored: 'stale' } : {}) }, { headers });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof InvalidUsageSnapshot) return Response.json({ error: 'Invalid snapshot' }, { status: 400, headers });
    return Response.json({ error: 'Sync unavailable' }, { status: 503, headers });
  }
}

import {env} from "cloudflare:workers";

export async function POST(request:Request){const key=(env as unknown as Record<string,string>).INGEST_TOKEN;if(!key||request.headers.get("Authorization")!==`Bearer ${key}`)return new Response("Unauthorized",{status:401});
 try{const data=await boundedJson(request),db=database(),statements=[];
  if(!Array.isArray(data.accounts)||data.accounts.length>40||!Array.isArray(data.changes)||data.changes.length>50)return new Response("Invalid batch",{status:400});

ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET label=excluded.label,balance=excluded.balance,unlimited=excluded.unlimited,observed_at=excluded.observed_at WHERE excluded.observed_at>=credit_accounts.observed_at").bind(account.id,account.label,account.balance===null?null:String(account.balance),account.unlimited?1:0,new Date(account.observedAt).toISOString()));

   statements.push(db.prepare("INSERT INTO credit_changes (id,account_id,direction,amount,usd_micros,before_balance,after_balance,observed_at,classification) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING").bind(change.id,change.accountId,direction,String(amount),usdMicros(amount,USD_PER_CREDIT),String(before),String(after),new Date(change.observedAt).toISOString(),direction==="decrease"?"pending":"observed"));
  }
  const status={lastSync:new Date().toISOString(),lastPoll:typeof data.status?.lastPoll==="string"?data.status.lastPoll:null,state:["ready","unavailable","no-account","identity-unavailable"].includes(data.status?.state)?data.status.state:"unavailable"};
  statements.push(db.prepare("INSERT INTO ledger_sync (id,payload) VALUES (1,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET payload=excluded.payload").bind(JSON.stringify(status)));
  await db.batch(statements);return Response.json({ok:true});
